description: Reviews agent invocations of mcp-cross-exam that contact an MCP target, start a stdio server, run write probes, or serve a fixture process. Help, version, probes list, probes plan, and config show are unmatched and keep first-party floors. Package launchers stay on command.package.python. Enabling this extension does not start Guard-invoked audits.
name: MCP Cross Exam
saferAlternatives: Use mcp-cross-exam --help, --version, probes list, probes plan, or config show to inspect the auditor without starting a target.
